Foundations / Typography

Foundations

Typography

The Halo UI type scale, font stacks, and the rules that keep text legible across every product.

stable

Halo UI uses a two-family system. Space Grotesk carries display and headings; Inter handles body and UI text. A single monospace family, JetBrains Mono, is reserved for code and tabular numerals.

Font stacks

css
--halo-font-display: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif;
--halo-font-body:    'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
--halo-font-mono:    'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;

Note

Both webfonts ship as variable fonts and are subset to Latin + Latin-Extended. The combined download is 34 kB woff2, loaded with font-display: swap.

Type scale

The scale is a 1.2 minor-third ratio anchored at a 16px base. Each step is a named token; product code references the token, never a raw pixel value.

TokenSize / line-heightWeightUsage
display-lg48 / 52600Marketing hero
display-sm36 / 42600Page titles
heading-lg28 / 36600Section h2
heading-sm22 / 30600Card / subsection h3
title18 / 26600List + dialog titles
body16 / 26400Default paragraph
body-sm14 / 22400Secondary text, captions
code14 / 22500Inline + block code
overline12 / 16600Eyebrows, all-caps labels

Ship faster, together

A scale you can trust

Body copy sits at 16px with a 26px line-height, tuned for sustained reading.

Secondary text drops to 14px for density without sacrificing legibility.

const ratio = 1.2 // minor third

html
<h1 class="halo-display-sm">Ship faster, together</h1>
<h2 class="halo-heading-lg">A scale you can trust</h2>
<p class="halo-body">Body copy sits at 16px with a 26px line-height.</p>
<p class="halo-body-sm">Secondary text drops to 14px for density.</p>

Measure & rhythm

Body text should run 60–75 characters per line. The docs content column is capped at --halo-measure: 68ch for exactly this reason. Vertical rhythm is maintained by spacing tokens (multiples of 4px), not by ad-hoc margins.

Do

Let headings inherit --halo-font-display and body inherit --halo-font-body automatically via the base reset.

Don't

Set type smaller than body-sm (14px) for any reading content — it fails our minimum legible-size guideline.

Respect user zoom

Always size text in rem, never px, so it scales with the browser's font setting. Halo's tokens emit rem values; if you override them, keep the unit.

Accessibility notes

  • Line-height is never below 1.5 for body text (WCAG 1.4.12).
  • Letter-spacing on all-caps overline text is 0.06em to preserve readability.
  • We do not rely on weight alone to convey meaning — pair it with size or color role.
